name: Ercan Kesal
bio: Ercan Kesal was born on 12 September 1959 in Avanos, Nevsehir, Turkey. He is an actor and writer, known for Once Upon a Time in Anatolia (2011), You Know Him (2020) and The Pit (2016). He has been married to Nazan Kesal since 2005.

credits.overview: A photographer returns to Cappadocia, where she grew up, to search for a lost camera. As the past resurfaces, the boundaries between memory, presence, and absence begin to dissolve.
